map.EV 值越大画面越亮吗？: Does a larger EV value make the picture brighter?
map.EV 描述场景亮度与曝光组合，数值越小代表光线越暗、需要越多曝光量。: EV describes the combination of scene brightness and exposure; a smaller value means less light and the need for more exposure.
map.EV₁₀₀ = log₂(N²/t) − log₂(S/100)；绝对曝光值 E: EV100 = log2(N^2/t) − log2(S/100); the absolute exposure value EV = log2(N^2/t); the equivalent shutter time t = 100*N^2/(S*2^EV100)
map.N 为光圈 f 值，t 为快门时间(s)，S 为 ISO。EV₁₀₀ 归一到 I: N is the aperture f value, t the shutter time (s) and S the ISO. EV100 normalises to ISO 100 so exposures across sensitivities can be compared; a difference of 1 EV corresponds to a doubling of light. Scene brightness is graded by EV100 (snow at noon >=16, the sunny 16 rule about 14, overcast about 12, night <=2).
